question: How do initial idle delay, approach, fitting and prepared aid change the outcomes/resources of current return policies?
consumer: Actual North Star Combat and ReturnGate models and maintained policies; standard Godot source and engine-dependent PCK. No copied Python combat or release-template execution.

observations.ground_without_brace_30_ticks: Only three trail-wrap approaches win; none win at 60/90/120 sampled ticks.
observations.zero_delay_work_losses: Steady/Riposte with riveted coat and none/heal; this fixed policy loss does not imply no viable route.

calibration_correction.initial_prediction: Default idle exposes and destroys the winch.
calibration_correction.observed: Body interception at the default spawn instead takes four hits and dies at tick 676; winch retains two integrity.
calibration_correction.consequence: Retain player-death control and add a separately marked off-line fixture for winch destruction; planned matrix unchanged.

production_consequence: Use the evaluator for concrete encounter/fitting/aid changes. Brace enables a fresh grounding commitment after damage where heal cannot; investigate cost/recovery clarity and alternate work paths. No automatic runtime rebalance or build rejection.

brain_contributions.ENG-004: Verifiable mechanical observations versus unestablished human experience.
brain_contributions.SCI-017: Controlled factors, explicit negative observations and repeatability.
brain_contributions.SCI-050: Useful bounded instrument without declaring a new implemented lab.
brain_contributions.CRE-005: Evaluate costs and recovery that actually change available action.

unchanged: Shipped gameplay source, data, PCK and standalone releases; capability states, engine decision, historical origins, protected knowledge and pins. Existing destination-execution evidence stays current.
limitations: Fixed policies at 60 Hz; initial idle delay is a controlled intervention, not human reaction time. Loss does not prove no feasible policy exists. Repetitions and deliveries are not independent participants. No enjoyment, balance, physical input, release-template or production-engine claim.
Perfect phase knowledge and ideal vectors; selected policies, wound/escort setup and delay points do not establish optimality, exact deadlines or general build viability.
No new laboratory, origin integration, final canon, class/build implementation, network trust or MMO readiness.
workflow_validation: Official checksum-verified actionlint 1.7.7, no diagnostics. Existing jobs retained; instrument tests and exact observation reproduction added.
